### Execution Result for Method 2 (Headless Browser Automation)

The headless automation suite was installed with Chromium and executed against Dreamina. Here is the exact status report:

```text
[BOT] Checking session status on Canvas...
[BOT] Session not logged in. Attempting login...
[BOT] Attempting direct login with provided credentials: ezzhisham585@gmail.com
[SECURITY BLOCK DETECTED]
ByteDance risk control blocked direct password submission from datacenter IP:
  -> "Couldn’t sign in. Try again later."
```

---

### Why This Happened
Dreamina (`dreamina.capcut.com`) is guarded by ByteDance risk control and anti-bot verification. When a direct email/password submission originates from a cloud runner/datacenter IP rather than a personal computer's residential IP, ByteDance blocks the automated login prompt.

---

### How to Complete the Automation

Choose one of the following two solutions:

#### Option 1: Provide Your Browser's `sessionid` Cookie (Fastest)
If you want the cloud runner to continue executing directly:
1. Open [dreamina.capcut.com](https://dreamina.capcut.com) in your regular web browser where you are logged in.
2. Open Developer Tools (`F12` or right-click -> **Inspect**).
3. Navigate to **Application** (or **Storage**) > **Cookies** > `https://dreamina.capcut.com`.
4. Copy the value of the **`sessionid`** cookie.
5. Paste it here or run:
   ```bash
   python3 dreamina_headless_bot.py --sessionid "YOUR_COPIED_SESSIONID_HERE"
   ```
   The bot will inject the authenticated session token directly, completely bypassing login and anti-bot checks.

---

#### Option 2: Run the Bot on Your Local Machine / Laptop
Because your local computer has a residential IP and a desktop display:
1. Clone your repo or pull the latest changes to your machine:
   ```bash
   git pull
   pip install playwright
   playwright install chromium
   ```
2. Run the one-time 30-second interactive session saver:
   ```bash
   python3 dreamina_headless_bot.py --save-session
   ```
   *(A browser window will open once so you can log in without any anti-bot block. The session cookies are saved to `./dreamina_session_profile`)*.
3. Run headlessly 24/7:
   ```bash
   python3 dreamina_headless_bot.py --run-headless
   ```

---

### Step-by-Step (Chrome, Edge, or Brave)

1. Open **[dreamina.capcut.com](https://dreamina.capcut.com)** in your web browser where you are already signed in.
2. Press **`F12`** on your keyboard (or right-click anywhere on the page and click **Inspect**).
3. At the top of the developer panel, click on the **Application** tab.  
   *(If you don't see "Application", click the small **`>>`** arrows at the top right of the panel to reveal it. In Firefox, this tab is called **Storage**).*
4. In the left-hand sidebar:
   - Click the arrow next to **Cookies** to expand it.
   - Click on **`https://dreamina.capcut.com`** (or `.capcut.com`).
5. Look down the **Name** column for **`sessionid`**.
6. Double-click on its **Value** (a long string of random letters and numbers) and copy it (`Ctrl + C` or `Cmd + C`).

---

### Alternative: 1-Click Cookie Extension (Easiest)

If you don't want to use Developer Tools:
1. Install the free **[Cookie-Editor](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/cookie-editor/hlkenndednhfkekhgcdicdfddnkalmdm)** extension for Chrome/Edge.
2. Open **[dreamina.capcut.com](https://dreamina.capcut.com)**.
3. Click the Cookie-Editor extension icon in your browser toolbar.
4. Click on **`sessionid`** and copy the value.

---

### What to do next:
Paste the copied string right here in the chat, and I will immediately inject it into the headless bot and run your canvas generation hands-free!

The URL you sent (`.../home?r_num=1795560517409`) is the page link from your browser. The `r_num` parameter is just a page timestamp—it is **not** the hidden authentication cookie.

Because you are using an **iPhone (iOS)**, Safari and mobile Chrome do not have an `F12` Developer Tools menu, so iOS does not let you copy hidden browser cookies directly from your phone.
